Overview

Rabat is a city in Rabat-Salé-Kénitra with a population of 577,000. The capital city of Morocco, blending historic landmarks with modern governance, featuring beautiful gardens and a relaxed coastal atmosphere. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
